before: Paragraph writes could not name w:bidi, and formatting writes named only the Latin run properties.
after: Paragraph writes can set or clear w:bidi, and run formatting on w:rtl or w:cs runs also writes w:bCs, w:iCs, w:szCs, and the w:rFonts cs slot.
reason: Collaboration replicates canonical primitive journals. The new writes produce ordinary w:pPr and w:rPr child elements and attributes that released readers already store and interpret, because documents and paste already contain them. No protocol, shared schema, repair, or canonical model rule changes.
